title: Midley's Mods
description: Tech-focused modpack while remaining somewhat vanilla.
body:
# Midley's Mods
Midley's Mods is a personal tech-focused modpack that I've been playing for the last couple of months, and I thought I'd share it so that other people could give it a shot.

## Included Mods
- Biomes O' Plenty
- Create
- Mekanism
- Refined Storage
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- ...and more!
